d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi philipins ki do divsiy saphal yatra puri karne ke bad svadesh laut aae hain. is yatra ke dauran unhonne tin bare antarrashtriy sammelnon men hissa liya aur vibhinn deshon ke vaishvik netaon ke sath dvipakshiy evan bahupakshiy muddon par sarthak charcha ki. vahin, esaaaeeaar ke tahat antim matdata suchi men patr nagrikon ka nam shamil karane ke lie ek aur avsar diya ja raha hai. rajy ke sabhi matdan kendron par ek aur avsar kainp lagae gae hain, jahan matdata suchi se juri trutiyon ke nirakran aur aavashyak aavedan ki prakriya men logon ki madad ki ja rahi hai.…
